page.title: Vessels | San Juan Island Whale Watching Tours
page.text:
Osprey (https://www.sanjuansafaris.com/vessels/osprey)

Osprey is our largest vessel, and the largest whale watching boat docked on San Juan Island!

Osprey is the largest vessel in our fleet. Coast Guard approved for 126 passengers and crew, this boat is ready to host your group event, party, or private charter! Osprey runs our Classic Whale Watch and Wildlife Safari daily in June through August.

Capacity: 126 Coast Guard approved for passengers and crew

Sea Lion (https://www.sanjuansafaris.com/vessels/sea-lion)

Our flagship vessel built specifically for wildlife viewing in the Pacific Northwest.

Sea Lion was built specifically for whale & wildlife viewing in the Pacific Northwest. This vessel is a staff favorite, as it provides an intimate experience while allowing for larger groups.

Capacity: 44 passengers

Kestrel (https://www.sanjuansafaris.com/vessels/kestrel)

Small boat, big adventure! Our fastest boat operating our Adventure tours.

Kestrel is our dedicated Adventure Tour vessel! This boat is perfect for intimate nature viewing and exciting boat experiences.

Capacity: 20 passengers

Larus (https://www.sanjuansafaris.com/larus)

Our newest boat perfect for inter-island transfers, water taxis, and small group charters.

The newest boat in our fleet of vessels, Larus is small but mighty! This boat is fast, making it perfect for water taxi services between the San Juan Islands.

Capacity: 6 passengers
